items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Yank was playing trombone... Rudolph was the drummer... Yank, he played at that time.

ctx.x: What kind of a band? They made some records. I mean, when you played with them, what type of music did they play? They made some records of some spirituals for one thing. Yeah. Well, I was playing trumpet when they made that. I was in that place. I had my own band. You see? I just wondered, when you were a member, what type of music they played?
Well, they played the Red Book numbers and they had some pretty good musicians there. Yank was playing trombone. Well, full shade. Some of the rag down numbers too.

Yeah, they played, yeah. I wondered because the first time you made your records you played the Climax Rag, which I've never heard of you before. Yeah. You seem to know all those old numbers. I know, man. Some of those with the Morgan Band things.
